title: Veal Morels
description:
Few combinations of three ingredients are as luscious as here: veal, morel mushrooms, and cream.
Of course, this could be made with chicken or pork tenderloin as the meat, or all kinds of different mush-rooms, or maybe a lighter pan- deglazed sauce, but these are the quintessential signature ingredients of this ethereal combination.
It’s a little on the expensive side, but well worth it for special occasions. And, it’s great with some buttered noodles and a simple salad dressed with oil and vinegar.

ingredients.h: Veal With a Morel Cream Sauce

ingredients: 4 veal chops, about ¾ pound each
Soak the morels in warm water to cover for at least 30 minutes.
Squeeze the morels to extract most of the liquid.
directions: Melt the remaining tablespoon of butter in a saucepan and add the shallots and cook briefly.
Add the morels and the dry white wine. Cook down by half.
Add the cream, cook about 1 minute, and add salt and pepper to taste.
Meanwhile, pour off the fat from the skillet in which the chops cooked. Add the Madeira and cook down until almost totally reduced.
Add the morels in cream sauce and blend. Heat the chops a little more in the sauce and serve in all together.
Sprinkle the chops with salt and pepper to taste. Dredge the chops on both sides in flour and shake off any excess.
Melt 3 tablespoons of butter in a heavy skillet and add the chops. Cook about 2-3 minutes or until the chops are nicely browned on one side.
Turn and cook on the second side 2-3 minutes. Transfer the chops to a warm platter.
